title: C: Stack (Array)
description: Implement a stack data structure using an array with push, pop, and peek operations.

steps.title: Stack Operations
steps.description: Define a `Stack` struct with int array and top index. Implement `void push(Stack *s, int val)`, `int pop(Stack *s)`, and `int peek(Stack *s)`. Push 10, 20, 30, pop once, peek, and print results.

verification.failureMessage: Pop should return 30, Peek should return 20
